# Mission 11: Boys In Blue (level31)

Set in Pelham on the night of 30 June 1979, after the police lock the area down when one of their own is killed. Cleon
sends Cochise, Vermin and Cowboy to find the scouts Fox and Snow; the Warriors end up fighting Birdie, a
wheelchair-bound lieutenant of the Turnbull AC, and his gang.

*This summary is paraphrased from web sources until our own walkthrough of the mission replaces it. Sources:*
